## Purpose

Describe the research or engineering problem and the behavior changed.

## Evidence

List commands actually run, their results and the evidence paths. Separate local,
browser, Docker and live cloud checks. Mark unperformed checks explicitly.

## Scientific and access boundaries

- [ ] Data origin, units, axes, time, source hashes and technical-well definitions remain explicit.
- [ ] Analysis does not consume generator truth; missing/zero controls are not imputed.
- [ ] Original measurements and exclusions are preserved.
- [ ] No credentials, bulk/customer data, notebook outputs or tenant state are included.
- [ ] Source package retains `rayfin/data` and all required runtime source.
- [ ] Documentation, generated contracts/notebook/diagrams and focused tests are current.
- [ ] No new public publishing, permissions, policy or capacity changes are implied.

## Remaining limitations

State scientific, security, dependency or deployment gates that remain open.
